story.text:
# C55
**Privacy is the seventh kind of capital, foundationally; its character is land-based RENTIER capital (data as soil): it yields rent by position, not value by aggregation; its worth is the appropriation share the consent interface sets; its exposure erodes on the adversary's background-information clock (C82); and it is leased, never conveyed, structural inalienability by non-reconstruction being the ownability mechanism. The five capital predicates survive; COMPOUNDING is scoped to reputational fertility only (a conjecture) and never to raw records. (Character ruled by First Person 2026-07-15 (soil, L140), register-synced 2026-07-17 (L149); the multiples 678x/31,000x are RETIRED as asserted facts suite-wide, surviving only as fenced lineage, same ruling.)**
